====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what exam-style thinking — guided writing: imaginative writing means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Guided Writing: Imaginative Writing.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
A learner studying ARABIC meets exam-style thinking — guided writing: imaginative writing first by naming the idea, then by using one Kenyan example from a home in Nakuru. In plain words: identify features of imaginative writing for information,.
